focus: Consolidation: ranked implementation phases by external-user impact against cost, with the restraint check applied
noveltyJustification: Eight consolidated phase proposals, each naming one file and one proving command and each checked against the reversal-cost order: surface hint, manifest de-pin, admission re-pin, stale canary removal, pi message, git-hooks trust warning, late-write test, Node floor alignment; deferred items and rejected layers recorded.
keyQuestions: Q10: Which smallest fixes survive the prevent-overengineering rule and how do they rank as implementation phases by external-user impact against cost?
answeredQuestions: Q10: Which smallest fixes survive the prevent-overengineering rule and how do they rank as implementation phases by external-user impact against cost?

Version-reservation service or changelog lock - a contract rule plus an origin/main read is smaller
Scratch-lifecycle manager, residual tracker, pin registry, guided installer - each adds a layer the existing convention or an edit already covers
HVR sweep now - deferred behind the P1 phases because it rewrites the always-loaded hub document's punctuation
Advisor battery signal additions - shared scoring surface owned by the advisor; rerun command is the battery
First-byte deadline semantics - wait for the Phase 7 late-write test and a measured host latency
P2 residuals from iteration 9 - recorded for later passes, not user-blocking today

label: Phase 1: pass the session surface hint at the advisor's compiled-route call. File: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/handlers/advisor-recommend.ts. Prove: the advisor compiled-route handler suite plus the surface-hint tests. Change an existing call; no new layer.

Phase 2: de-pin the hub count in the compiled-route manifest test. File: .skilled/bin/tests/compiled-route-manifest.test.cjs. Replace 'all 6 hubs' with the count-agnostic shape the CLI prints at seven sites. Prove: node --test .skilled/bin/tests/compiled-route-manifest.test.cjs.

Phase 3: re-pin the live corpus count and rerun the baseline report it guards. File: .skilled/bin/tests/compiled-route-admission.test.cjs. Set LIVE_CORPUS_SIZE from 80 to the measured 86 and rerun the named baseline report. Prove: node --test .skilled/bin/tests/compiled-route-admission.test.cjs expects tests 29 pass 29 fail 0.

Phase 4: remove the stale jev-transport-single case from the cli-external fixture. File: .skilled/bin/lib/compiled-routing/009-parent-hub-rollout/004-cli-external-orchestration/fixtures/canary-cases.v1.json. The cli-classifier fixture's jev-choice-single already covers the prompt. Prove: the hub canary harness no longer reports a defer against a route expectation.

Phase 5: give the pi ambiguous-branch denial a next step. File: .skilled/hooks/dispatch/pi/dispatch-preflight-lint.ts. One clause naming what makes a command direct, mirroring the sibling branch. Prove: a focused shouldDenyPiDispatch case asserting the new text.

Phase 6: surface the git-hooks trust state where it silently disables enforcement. File: .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit. When the untrusted repository carries its own install-git-hooks.sh, print one stderr line naming skilled.trustRepoHooks true; foreign repositories stay silent. Prove: bash .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/tests/pre-commit.test.sh with untrusted-toolchain and foreign-repo cases.

Phase 7: pin the late-write loss with one test case. File: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/hooks/lib/hook-stdin-deadline.test.mjs. Write a short-deadline payload after about 800 ms and assert the observed outcome. Prove: node --test .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/hooks/lib/hook-stdin-deadline.test.mjs.

Phase 8: align the Node floor with the dependency floor. File: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/package.json with the README line as the doc half. Set engines.node to ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Prove: npm --prefix .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit install --dry-run below the floor reports the engine refusal, and installs on a supported Node.
